title: A Bug's Life
intro: [excited] Welcome, welcome! Tonight's episode is crawling with insects, critters and creepy-crawly clues. [chuckles] If something tickles your ankle... just keep playing. It's A BUG'S LIFE!

art.prompt: A giant dewy meadow seen from an ant's height, towering blades of grass, glowing mushrooms, a leaf canopy, ladybugs and fireflies sparkling in warm golden-hour light Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Ant-ics
categories.intro: [laughs] This first category is all about A Bug's Life. Don't bug out!

art.prompt: A tiny ant colony village carved into a tree root with leaf-boat docks, seed stockpiles and a dandelion tower under morning sun Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In A Bug's Life, the ants must gather food every year for this gang of bullying insects
clues.reveal: The correct answer is grasshoppers! [sarcastic] Hopper and his gang. Real charmers.

clues.clue: Flik's love interest is this princess, who is next in line to become queen of the colony
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Princess Atta! Her little sister Dot is the real scene-stealer though.

clues.clue: Flik recruits a group of 'warrior' bugs who turn out to be performers from this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a flea circus! [chuckles] Run by P.T. Flea himself.

clues.clue: To scare off Hopper, the ants build a fake one of these predators
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bird! [gasps] Grasshoppers' worst nightmare, made of leaves and twigs.

clues.clue: A Bug's Life was Pixar's feature film number this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is number two, released in 1998 right after Toy Story! [excited] TWO for the bugs!

categories.title: Creepy Crawlies
categories.intro: [whispers] Tiny legs, big personalities... name these Disney bugs!

art.prompt: A cozy nighttime garden with a cricket's tiny top hat and umbrella on a mushroom, fireflies and a dragonfly glowing nearby Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Pinocchio, this top-hatted insect sings When You Wish Upon a Star
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jiminy Cricket! [laughs] Always let your conscience be your guide.

clues.clue: In Mulan, Grandmother Fa gives Mulan this lucky cricket
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cri-Kee! Lucky? [sarcastic] Well... mostly.

clues.clue: In Alice in Wonderland, this blue bug blows smoke letters and asks Alice, 'Who are you?'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Caterpillar! W-H-O are YOU? [chuckles]

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Bernard and Bianca's swamp boat is powered by this hard-working dragonfly
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Evinrude! Named after a famous brand of boat motor. [laughs] Vroom vroom!

clues.clue: In James and the Giant Peach, this nervous, gloomy critter travels with James, the Centipede and the Ladybug
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Earthworm! [sighs] Nervous, but brave when it counts.

categories.title: Parks Are Buggin'
categories.intro: [excited] Bugs in the parks! Shows, lands and festivals all buzzing with critters.

art.prompt: A huge sculpted fantasy tree covered in carved animals at the center of a theme park, butterflies and flower topiaries all around Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Before it closed in 2025, this 3D show inside Animal Kingdom's Tree of Life starred Flik and Hopper
clues.answer: It's Tough to Be a Bug!
accept: its tough to be a bug
it's tough to be a bug
choices: It's Tough to Be a Bug!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is It's Tough to Be a Bug! [laughs] Remember the stink bug? Your nose does.

clues.clue: It's Tough to Be a Bug was replaced in 2025 by a 4D show based on this animal-city film
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! The new show is Zootopia: Better Zoogether.

clues.clue: During the EPCOT International Flower and Garden Festival, guests can walk through a tent full of these fluttering insects
clues.reveal: The correct answer is butterflies! [whispers] Stand still and one might land on you.

clues.clue: Disney California Adventure's A Bug's Land closed in 2018 to make room for this Marvel land
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Avengers Campus! From Flik to Spider-Man, still a land of web-slingers.

clues.clue: A Bug's Land had a kiddie train ride named after this hungry German caterpillar
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heimlich's Chew Chew Train! [chuckles] Next stop... a candy corn!

categories.title: Small Wonders
categories.intro: [chuckles] Not bugs, but tiny critters with HUGE personalities. Name them!

art.prompt: A miniature mouse-sized Victorian street made of teacups, thimbles and matchboxes, lit by tiny lanterns at dusk Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Pocahontas, this mischievous raccoon loves to steal food
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Meeko! [laughs] A bandit with a mask and everything.

clues.clue: In Dumbo, this brave little mouse becomes Dumbo's best friend and manager
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Timothy Q. Mouse! Small mouse, BIG pep talks.

clues.clue: In Frozen II, Elsa befriends this little fire spirit salamander
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bruni! [excited] Cute, purple, and occasionally on fire.

clues.clue: In The Great Mouse Detective, Basil's arch-enemy is this sewer rat who insists he's a big mouse
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Professor Ratigan! [whispers] Don't call him a rat to his face.

clues.clue: Ratigan's sneaky henchman with a peg leg is this kind of animal
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bat, named Fidget! [mischievously] Peg leg, broken wing, and STILL causing trouble.
